data.name: numericBoxSampleTilt.ToolTip
data.value: Sample tilt angle in the SEM, in degrees (-90 to 0; typically -70 for EBSD); sets the backscatter projection geometry.

data.name: waveLengthControl.ToolTip
data.value: Set the accelerating voltage / electron wavelength of the incident beam (the primary-electron energy for the EBSD simulation).

data.name: buttonViewQuarter.ToolTip
data.value: Set the 3D geometry view to an oblique bird's-eye viewpoint.

data.name: buttonViewFromSurfaceNormal.ToolTip
data.value: Set the 3D geometry view to look along the sample surface normal.

data.name: buttonFromX.ToolTip
data.value: Set the 3D geometry view to look along the X axis (the sample rotation axis).

data.name: buttonViewFromZ.ToolTip
data.value: Set the 3D geometry view to look along the Z axis (the electron-beam direction).

data.name: buttonSimulateBSE.ToolTip
data.value: Run a Monte Carlo simulation of BSE (BackScattered Electron) trajectories to compute the exit-energy and depth distributions used to weight the EBSD pattern.

data.name: buttonFitNistElasticSampler.ToolTip
data.value: Developer tool: compress the NIST elastic-scattering cross-section tables (E_*.TXT) with PCHIP interpolation and emit generated source.

data.name: checkBoxDrawAxesInStereonet.ToolTip
data.value: Overlay the crystal a (red), b (green) and c (blue) axes on the stereonet (stereographic projection of the BSE distribution), labelling both the + and - directions. The stereonet centre is the sample surface normal.

data.name: numericBoxDetTilt.ToolTip
data.value: Set the tilt angle of the detector plane in degrees relative to the beam (Z) axis. This affects the camera length and the projected shape of the Kikuchi bands.

data.name: numericBoxZofDet.ToolTip
data.value: Set the Z coordinate (along the beam direction) of the detector center, in mm. Together with Y it determines the camera length.

data.name: numericBoxYofDet.ToolTip
data.value: Set the Y coordinate of the detector center, in mm - the sample-to-screen offset within the sample-surface plane, perpendicular to the X rotation axis. Together with Z and the detector tilt it determines the camera length. (Left-right offset is set by X.)

data.name: trackBarStrSize.ToolTip
data.value: Adjust the font size of the overlay index text.

data.name: colorControlExcessLine.ToolTip
data.value: Set the color used to draw the Kikuchi lines.

data.name: trackBarLineWidth.ToolTip
data.value: Set the line width (pen thickness) used to draw the Kikuchi lines.

data.name: labelLineWidth.ToolTip
data.value: Set the line width (pen thickness) used to draw the Kikuchi lines.

data.name: colorControlString.ToolTip
data.value: Set the color of overlay text, including Kikuchi-line and zone-axis index labels.

data.name: colorControlBackGround.ToolTip
data.value: Set the background color of the EBSD pattern view. It is also the color that weak Kikuchi lines fade into when 'Apply structure factors' is on.

data.name: radioButtonKikuchiThresholdOfStructureFactor.ToolTip
data.value: Select reflections for Kikuchi lines by taking the strongest ones ranked by structure factor.

data.name: checkBoxKikuchiLine_Kinematical.Text
data.value: Apply structure factors to Kikuchi line intensity

data.name: checkBoxKikuchiLine_Kinematical.ToolTip
data.value: Weight the Kikuchi lines by the kinematical structure factor, blending each line's color toward the background in proportion to its intensity, so strong reflections are drawn in the full line color and weak ones fade out.

data.name: radioButtonKikuchiThresholdOfLength.ToolTip
data.value: Select reflections for Kikuchi lines by a reciprocal-spacing (1/d) cutoff.

data.name: numericBoxKikuchiThresholdOfStructureFactor.ToolTip
data.value: Number of strongest reflections (Top N, ranked by structure factor = amplitude scattered by one unit cell) to draw as Kikuchi lines. Larger values show more lines.

data.name: numericBoxKikuchiThresholdOfLength.ToolTip
data.value: Cutoff on reciprocal spacing 1/d (nm^-1). Only Kikuchi lines whose 1/d is below this value are drawn, so lower values keep only larger-d-spacing reflections.

data.name: labelTextSize.ToolTip
data.value: Adjust the font size of the overlay index text.

data.name: numericBoxThicknessStep.ToolTip
data.value: Step size of the sample-thickness scan, in nm; the range from Start to End is calculated at this increment.

data.name: numericBoxMaxNumOfG.ToolTip
checkBoxNonLocalAbsorption.ToolTip
data.value: Use the non-local absorption model (complex optical potential accounting for thermal-diffuse scattering) when building the master pattern.

data.name: checkBoxTDSBackground.ToolTip
data.value: Include TDS (Thermal Diffuse Scattering) background intensity in the master pattern.

data.name: numericBoxThicknessStart.ToolTip
data.value: Start of the sample-thickness scan range, in nm; Start, End, and Step define the thickness slices to calculate.

data.name: numericBoxThicknessEnd.ToolTip
data.value: End of the sample-thickness scan range, in nm; Start, End, and Step define the thickness slices to calculate.

data.name: buttonStop.ToolTip
data.value: Stop the running master-pattern (Monte-Carlo / Bloch-wave) calculation.

data.name: numericBoxEnergy.ToolTip
data.value: Shows the electron energy (keV) of the EBSD pattern slice currently rendered (single-slice mode).

data.name: trackBarOutputEnergy.ToolTip
data.value: Select which energy slice (keV) of the EBSD pattern to render in single-slice mode; the value is shown in the Energy box.

data.name: numericBoxDepth.ToolTip
data.value: Shows the depth (nm) of the EBSD pattern slice currently rendered (single-slice mode).

data.name: trackBarOutputThickness.ToolTip
labelPolarity.ToolTip
data.value: Select normal or inverted (negative) gray-level polarity for the displayed image.

data.name: labelColor.ToolTip
data.value: Select the color scale (Gray, Cold-Warm, Spectrum, Fire) used to map intensity to color.

data.name: checkBoxWithBSEDistribution.Text
data.value: Show image with BSE angular/energy distributions

data.name: checkBoxWithBSEDistribution.ToolTip
data.value: Render the EBSD pattern weighted by the simulated BSE (BackScattered Electron) energy and depth distribution, integrating over all slices instead of showing a single energy/depth slice. Run Simulate first to obtain the distribution.

data.name: comboBoxGradient.ToolTip
data.value: Choose Positive or Negative (inverted) grayscale for the pattern intensity.

data.name: comboBoxScale.ToolTip
data.value: Choose the color scale mapping intensity to color (Gray, Cold-Warm, Spectrum, or Fire).

data.name: trackBarIntensityBrightnessMax.ToolTip
data.value: Set the upper brightness (white-clip) level of the displayed EBSD image as a fraction of the intensity range; pixels at or above this map to white.

data.name: trackBarIntensityBrightnessMin.ToolTip
data.value: Set the lower brightness (black-clip) level of the displayed EBSD image as a fraction of the intensity range; pixels at or below this map to black.

data.name: labelBrightnessMax.ToolTip
data.value: Set the upper brightness (white-clip) level of the displayed EBSD image as a fraction of the intensity range; pixels at or above this map to white.

data.name: labelBrightnessMin.ToolTip
data.value: Set the lower brightness (black-clip) level of the displayed EBSD image as a fraction of the intensity range; pixels at or below this map to black.

data.name: labelBrightness.ToolTip
data.value: Adjust the brightness (black/white clip) range of the displayed EBSD image.

data.name: checkBoxShowOverlays.ToolTip
data.value: Overlay Kikuchi lines, indices, zone axes and the detector outline on top of the pattern.

data.name: buttonCopyImage.ToolTip
data.value: Copy the pattern view to the clipboard using the range, resolution and format selected here (the Kikuchi-line and index overlays are included as drawn).

data.name: numericBoxEnergyEnd.ToolTip
data.value: End (lower) energy of the backscattered electrons used in the EBSD (Electron Backscatter Diffraction) scan, in keV.

data.name: numericBoxEnergyStart.ToolTip
data.value: Start (upper) energy of the backscattered electrons used in the EBSD (Electron Backscatter Diffraction) scan, in keV.

data.name: numericBoxEnergyStep.ToolTip
data.value: Step size of the backscattered-electron energy scan, in keV; energies are calculated from Start down to End by this increment.

data.name: labelBseDepth.ToolTip
data.value: Distribution of the depth (nm) at which the detected backscattered electrons had their last inelastic scattering event (falling back to the maximum penetration depth when there was none). This is the same depth definition used to weight the master pattern.

data.name: labelBseDeltaE.ToolTip
data.value: Distribution of the energy loss ΔE (keV) of the simulated backscattered electrons.

data.name: checkBoxShowDyanmicalEBSD.ToolTip
data.value: Show the dynamical EBSD (Electron BackScatter Diffraction) pattern projected from the master pattern; unchecked leaves a plain background.

data.name: checkBoxDrawDetectorOutline.ToolTip
data.value: Overlay the outline of the detector (phosphor screen) on the pattern. Enables the detector-outline options group.

data.name: labelBseStereonetNote.Text
data.value: The stereonet center is the surface normal direction

data.name: labelBseStereonetNote.ToolTip
data.value: In this stereonet, the center corresponds to the sample surface normal.

data.name: checkBoxShowKikuchiLines.ToolTip
data.value: Show the Kikuchi lines (the band-like diffraction features formed by inelastically scattered electrons). Enables the Kikuchi-line options group.

data.name: checkBoxShowGIndices.ToolTip
data.value: Show the (h k l) reflection indices labeling each Kikuchi line (band).

data.name: checkBoxShowZoneAxisIndices.ToolTip
data.value: Label the zone axes [u v w] at the intersections of the Kikuchi bands.

data.name: labelMasterPatternGrid.ToolTip
data.value: Resolution (pixels per side) of the square Lambert master-pattern grid (64–2048).

data.name: comboBoxMasterPatternGrid.ToolTip
data.value: Resolution (pixels per side) of the square Lambert master-pattern grid (64–2048); larger is finer but slower.

data.name: numericBoxMasterPatternEnergy.ToolTip
data.value: Shows the electron energy (keV) of the master-pattern slice currently selected by the energy slider for preview.

data.name: trackBarMasterPatternEnergy.ToolTip
data.value: Select which energy slice (keV) of the master pattern to preview; the value is shown in the Energy box.

data.name: numericBoxMasterPatternDepth.ToolTip
data.value: Shows the depth (nm) of the master-pattern slice currently selected by the depth slider for preview.

data.name: trackBarMasterPatternDepth.ToolTip
data.value: Select which depth slice (nm) of the master pattern to preview; the value is shown in the Depth box.

data.name: labelMasterPattern2DHemisphere.ToolTip
data.value: Choose which hemisphere (+Z or -Z) of the master pattern is shown in the 2D view.

data.name: comboBoxMasterPattern2DHemisphere.ToolTip
data.value: Choose which hemisphere (+Z or -Z) of the master pattern is shown in the 2D view.

data.name: buttonCreateMasterPattern.ToolTip
data.value: Build the EBSD master pattern (the full-sphere dynamical backscatter intensity map) via Monte-Carlo then Bloch-wave (Bethe) dynamical diffraction.

data.name: buttonMasterPattern2DCopy.ToolTip
data.value: Copy the 2D (Lambert-projection) master-pattern image to the clipboard.

data.name: buttonMasterPattern3DCopy.ToolTip
data.value: Copy the 3D (spherical) master-pattern preview to the clipboard.

data.name: checkBoxMasterPattern3DAxisLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Show the a, b, c axis-label text on the 3D master-pattern view.

data.name: buttonMasterPattern3DViewAlong.ToolTip
data.value: Rotate the 3D master pattern so the zone axis [u v w] entered at right faces the viewer.

data.name: indexControl.ToolTip
data.value: Enter the zone-axis indices [u v w] used by the 'View Along' button to orient the 3D master pattern.

data.name: checkBoxShowMesh.ToolTip
data.value: Draw the detector division grid (mesh lines) on the pattern.

data.name: checkBoxShowCircle.ToolTip
data.value: Draw the yellow rectangle marking the detector (phosphor screen) outline on the pattern. It is left out when copying the Detector range, since the copy edge already coincides with it.

data.name: labelExpBrightness.ToolTip
data.value: Adjust the black/white clip range of the overlaid experimental image (not the simulated pattern), using the Min and Max sliders on the right.

data.name: checkBoxMasterPattern3DAxisArrows.ToolTip
data.value: Show the crystal-axis (a, b, c) arrow inset on the 3D master-pattern view.

data.name: checkBoxFlipDetectorLeftRight.ToolTip
data.value: Mirror the pattern and all its overlays left-right. Unchecked (default) is the view from the detector towards the sample, i.e. the pattern as an EBSD camera records it; check this only if your experimental image has the opposite handedness.

data.name: checkBoxShowExperimentalImage.ToolTip
data.value: Overlay the experimental EBSD image (dragged and dropped onto this window) on the detector area, above the simulated pattern and below the Kikuchi-line overlays.

data.name: labelExpMinInt.ToolTip
data.value: Black point of the overlaid experimental image, as a fraction of its own intensity range (logarithmic slider). Pixels at or below this become black.

data.name: trackBarExpImageMinInt.ToolTip
data.value: Black point of the overlaid experimental image, as a fraction of its own intensity range (logarithmic slider). Pixels at or below this become black.

data.name: labelExpMaxInt.ToolTip
data.value: White point of the overlaid experimental image, as a fraction of its own intensity range (logarithmic slider). Pixels at or above this become white.

data.name: trackBarExpImageMaxInt.ToolTip
data.value: White point of the overlaid experimental image, as a fraction of its own intensity range (logarithmic slider). Pixels at or above this become white.

data.name: labelExpOpacity.ToolTip
data.value: Opacity of the overlaid experimental image, from 0 (invisible) to 100 % (opaque). Lower it to see the simulated pattern underneath.

data.name: trackBarExpImageOpacity.ToolTip
data.value: Opacity of the overlaid experimental image, from 0 (invisible) to 100 % (opaque). Lower it to see the simulated pattern underneath.

data.name: radioButtonIndexingRadon.ToolTip
data.value: Search orientations by matching kinematical Kikuchi-band templates against the Radon (line-detection) map of the experimental image. Works without a master pattern; with one, the candidates are re-ranked by robust ZNCC (zero-mean normalized cross-correlation).

data.name: radioButtonIndexingDictionary.ToolTip
data.value: Search orientations by generating dictionary patterns from the dynamical master pattern over all orientations and comparing them all by robust ZNCC. Requires the master pattern and takes a few seconds, but is more reliable than Radon search.

data.name: buttonFindOrientation.ToolTip
data.value: Search the orientations that best explain the loaded experimental pattern, using the engine selected above. Up to 10 candidates are listed in the table below; the top one is refined to +-0.25 deg when a master pattern is available.

data.name: dataGridViewEbsdCandidates.ToolTip
data.value: Orientation candidates from the last search, best first. Score = Radon band-evidence z-value, ZNCC = correlation with the simulated pattern, Bands and (hkl) = matched bands (Radon search only). Click a row to apply that orientation to the whole program.

data.name: buttonCalibrateGeometry.ToolTip
data.value: Refine the detector geometry - pattern centre (PC) and detector distance (DD) - together with the orientation, by maximizing the ZNCC between the simulated and experimental patterns. Requires the master pattern. The detector tilt is kept fixed, and the result is written back to the detector centre X/Y/Z boxes.

data.name: checkBoxMatchDetectorResolution.ToolTip
data.value: Copy at the detector's own pixel size, i.e. one image pixel = one detector pixel. Combined with the 'Detector' range the output matches the detector pixel count exactly; the longer side is clamped to 4096 px. Unchecked, the on-screen resolution is used.

data.name: radioButtonCopyCurrent.ToolTip
data.value: Copy the area currently shown in the pattern view, exactly as panned and zoomed (the yellow detector outline is included if it is displayed).

data.name: radioButtonDetector.ToolTip
data.value: Copy only the detector (phosphor screen) area, regardless of the current pan and zoom. The yellow detector outline is left out, so the image ends exactly at the detector edge.

data.name: radioButtonCopyEmf.ToolTip
data.value: Copy as an Enhanced Metafile (emf) vector image (default). The Kikuchi lines and index labels stay vector and scale without pixelation; only the pattern itself is embedded as a raster.

data.name: radioButtonCopyBmp.ToolTip
data.value: Copy as a bitmap (bmp) raster image. Everything, including the Kikuchi lines and labels, is rasterized at a fixed resolution. Use this for programs that cannot paste metafiles.

data.name: labelDetectorSizeTilt.ToolTip
data.value: Geometry of the detector screen: its tilt angle in degrees relative to the beam axis, and its size in pixels (Width x Height).

data.name: numericBoxDetWidth.ToolTip
data.value: Number of detector pixels along the horizontal direction (1 to 4096). The physical width is this value times Resolution (mm/pixel). Loading an experimental image sets it to the width of that image.

data.name: numericBoxDetHeight.ToolTip
data.value: Number of detector pixels along the vertical direction (1 to 4096). The physical height is this value times Resolution (mm/pixel). Loading an experimental image sets it to the height of that image.

data.name: labelDetectorResolution.ToolTip
data.value: Physical size of one detector pixel, in mm (0.0001 to 10). The detector area is Width x Height pixels times this value. This is not the display zoom - that is the Resolution box in the view settings.

data.name: numericBoxDetResolution.ToolTip
data.value: Physical size of one detector pixel, in mm (0.0001 to 10). The detector area is Width x Height pixels times this value. This is not the display zoom - that is the Resolution box in the view settings.

data.name: labelDetectorCenter.ToolTip
data.value: Position of the detector center in mm (X, Y, Z), measured from the point where the beam hits the sample. Y and Z together with the tilt determine the camera length; X is the left-right offset.

data.name: numericBoxXofDet.ToolTip
data.value: Set the X coordinate of the detector center, in mm - the left-right (lateral) offset of the screen along the sample tilt axis. Y and Z set the in-plane offset and the camera length. (Range -1000 to 1000.)

data.name: numericBoxResolution.ToolTip
data.value: Display resolution of the pattern view, in mm per screen pixel (0.0001 to 10). Smaller values zoom in. This affects the view only - the detector's own pixel size is set by Resolution on the detector geometry side.

data.name: sizeControl.ToolTip
data.value: Size of the pattern view in screen pixels (width x height). Changing it resizes the window. The detector's own pixel count is not affected.
